title: Choose the new product-overview structure
question: Each option explains the same complete ExamUploadKit journey. Choose the reading pattern that busy Reddit, X and LinkedIn users should understand fastest.

options.label: Guided application map
options.thesis: One continuous route from finding an exam to submitting the prepared files.
options.viewport: A numbered route crosses every slide; each stop expands one real product moment and hands the eye to the next.
options.risk: Needs disciplined pacing so the route guides rather than decorates.

options.label: Mobile control panels
options.thesis: A phone-led walkthrough pairs each action with the rule or system response it triggers.
options.viewport: One phone anchors each frame while magnified fragments explain search, requirements, processing, review and checkout.
options.risk: Can feel like an app tutorial if the product mechanism is not made visually dominant.

options.label: Rules-to-result chain
options.thesis: Every slide shows what the candidate supplies, what the exam requires and what ExamUploadKit produces.
options.viewport: A repeated input → rule → result chain changes scale and composition at each stage of the journey.
options.risk: The repeated logic must vary visually or it can become diagrammatic.
